$comment: The transport registry, in one machine-readable place. `execute-spec-in-fork` carried the transport list in prose across three places — the ordered detection list, one route section per transport, and the README tables — with nothing tying them together, so adding a fourth transport meant remembering 7-8 hand edits and any miss left the router describing a transport the code did not have. This file is the list; scripts/transport-gate.mjs asserts the skill still agrees with it. It deliberately does NOT generate the prose (the wording is the skill's job) — it only refuses to let the two drift apart silently.

detectionList.heading: ## Pick the transport (detect in this order)

transports.note: Harness-specific tool names live only in this route's capability table.
The machine-locked route: spawn_execution / check_mailbox / ack_receipt.
The honest fallback. A missing transport is named, never simulated.
